field_map.zone|psr|ts|resolution|mw — event-identi: bidding zone + PSRTYPE_MAPPINGS fuel code + UTC point timestamp + publication resolution + VALUE — a revised value is a new vintage (appended), an exact re-publication is a duplicate (dropped)
field_map.psr: entsoe-py canonical PSRTYPE_MAPPINGS code (B01-B25 etc) identifying the fuel/generation technology; see server/euGenerationMix.ts for the full table
field_map.ts: UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM computed as period start + (position-1) x resolution — points stored as PUBLISHED; absent positions stay absent, never interpolated
field_map.mw: actual generation for that fuel type in MW; empty quantities are null, never zero

confidence_model: RAW official TSO-reported realised generation-by-fuel-type. HYPOTHESIS (gate-locked): zonal fuel-mix share (renewables vs fossil gas/coal, hourly) is a gas-burn/carbon-price demand proxy and a ground-truth cross-check against GEM's announced/under-construction capacity mix — the EU analog of EPA CAMD's US unit-level utilization truth (census section 3 #1). Nothing traded or sold until ladder gates.
geo_fields: zone (bidding-zone code; EIC in euLoad.ts's shared ZONES map)
cadence: realised generation publishes with ~1-2h lag at zone-native resolution; 2h poll with a 48h trailing window per zone
